note: Spend-only rule for `txns author` (FR-B3, ADR 0004). A ledger row is kept only when its source is in spend_sources, its account category is not in excluded_categories, and it has a debit and no credit (credit lines are never spend). Labour repairs stay: `Repairs and Maintenance-Labor` is deliberately not excluded. A source in neither list stops `author` (exit 2) until it is added to one of them. Reasons are for review only. subscription_categories marks the accounts whose rows count as subscriptions for the holiday share.

excluded_sources.(blank): journal lines with no source, e.g. monthly depreciation
excluded_sources.Receive Money: money received: refunds and returned cash

excluded_categories.Bad Debts Expense: write-offs of sold services, not a purchase
excluded_categories.Consulting & Accounting: pays people for their time (bookkeeping and consultancy retainers)
excluded_categories.Miscellaneous Expense: staff cash advances and loan remittances, reversed by receipts
excluded_categories.Office Expense - Utility/Labor: pays utility staff by the day
